portfolio_observations: The portfolio exhibits a deliberate tilt toward domestic financial deepening and consumer discretionary cycles, balanced by selective exposure to global IT services.
Active risk is financed largely through underweight positions in heavy cyclicals and commodity-linked sectors, namely Capital Goods, Metals & Mining, and Energy.
Active sector tilts remain disciplined within a tight +/- 3% band, indicating that performance will predominantly be driven by stock selection rather than high-conviction macro factor divergence.
